name: Vietnam ETS Pilot 2024
notes: Placeholder scenario for engine development, built from public documentation only; no content is taken from the CarbonSim application. Parameters follow the Vietnam training exercise as documented publicly: cap 355,850,000 t, -3%/yr, 90% free, 4 auctions per year, price collar 100/300, 10% offset limit, penalty 300 plus one allowance, 10% exchange volatility band, auctions open 45% of the year, 20 minutes per virtual year. Sector emission shares follow the covered-emissions split in the ETS Task 9 technical report (power 43%, cement 33%, steel 24%). All company names are original fiction written for this project. AI participants are placeholders named 'AI <Sector> NN'. Unit baseline emissions are placeholders: year-1 business-as-usual totals exactly the cap, split evenly inside each sector, so the fleet starts short by the volume auctioned and the gap widens as the cap falls. Company capital is a placeholder at 500 x the unit's baseline emissions, with a credit limit of half that and 7%/yr interest on a negative balance. Unit operating profit is a placeholder at 40 currency units per tonne of baseline emissions. Abatement menus are placeholders, sized as a share of each unit's baseline and priced per tonne. Replace these placeholders when the Vietnam instance data or the trainer parameter sheets are available.
